text:
olivia park: Heads-up: qz6b 4-bit quant benchmark results show a spike in perplexity for the legal-domain prompt slice we added last week. Noticed more hallucinated citations and truncated footnotes.

kevin wu: Can you share the bench snapshot and a failing example?

olivia park: Bench snapshot: `bench://qz6b-2026-03-21-legal-run-47` (uploaded). Example prompt: ```
{"context":"In the matter of Smith v. Jones, summarize the precedent regarding duty of care across jurisdictions... (long)"}
``` Model output (quant): ```
{"summary":"The court held that...","citations":["Smith v. Jone\u0000"],"notes":"truncated"}
```

priya rao: That's worrying. Did the quant pipeline change recently?

kevin wu: We merged packing-change-2 in PR #633 last week which modified token alignment for long sequences. float baseline and qz6b-int8 are clean. Only 4-bit folding seems impacted.

maria gonzalez: From a curation perspective: do NOT remove these legal anchors from the golden set. Instead create a focused golden subset for legal-long and add them to regression. We need examples to triage.

labeler-bot: Created ticket ML-1420: qz6b-4bit legal-domain hallucination/truncation. Assignees: @kevin wu, @derek cho.

bench-bot: Quick stats: legal-long slice (n=1200) median perplexity up 22% vs float, truncated outputs 4.8% -> exceeds our 3% threshold.

derek cho: I'll repro locally with `scripts/repro/qz6b_4bit_legal.sh` and attach tokenizer flags.

priya rao: On promptset ops: propose we augment the legal-longholdout with 2k synthetic jurisdiction mixes (US/EU/SG), then run fuzzy-hash-v3 dedupe to avoid inflating duplicates. Also increase sampler weight for legal-long to 4x in holdout.

olivia park: Good. Also add language markers around citations in the golden examples so tokenization boundaries are explicit when we run quant.

labeler-bot: Label batch LB-4999 created (500 items) -> task: mark TRUNCATED/MALFORMED/HALLUCINATED/OK and capture "citation_loss" boolean. Assigning to legal-annotators.

maria gonzalez: Update labeler guide to include examples of citation truncation vs intentional redaction. Avoid inflating false positives.

kevin wu: If failing rate >3% on legal-long vs float, block 4-bit fold merges. Will add a CI check pointing at the new holdout file.

infra-bot: Snapshot saved: snapshot://golden-legal-2026-03-21 sha:ff9a1b. Stored at /eval/snapshots/golden-legal-2026-03-21.

derek cho: Early labeler results: LB-4999 -> 500 queued, 120 completed: 9 HALLUCINATED, 6 TRUNCATED, 2 AMBIG.

priya rao: I'll create quarantine branch `promptbank/quarantine/legal-long-2026-03` and tag flagged anchors with `quarantine/quant` and `regression/legal`. Do not delete.

olivia park: I'll run a small A/B eval: float vs qz6b-4bit on the snapshot and push metrics to the dashboard.

bench-bot: A/B results posted: float: avg BLEU 0.72, qz6b-4bit: 0.59 on legal-long holdout.

maria gonzalez: That's a clear regression. Steps: 1) quarantine and snapshot (done), 2) label and add to regression suite, 3) triage packing-change-2 in ML-1420, 4) run dedupe & augment.

kevin wu: Opening ML-1421 to add bounds-checks and token-type guards in the 4-bit folding path. If quick fix fails, revert PR #633.

priya rao: We'll also add the failing gold labels to `tests/regressions/legal_long` so future PRs can't regress silently.

labeler-bot: LB-4999 tags: `regression/quant`, `quarantine/legal-long`.

olivia park: Thanks team. One quick ask for DS: include tokenizer flag set and byte offsets in the saved example so we can correlate where the truncation happens.

derek cho: Will attach offsets in ML-1420. Also adding unit reproducer in PR.

maria gonzalez: Schedule a short curation + infra sync tomorrow. We need annotator guidance and a plan for CI enforcement.

kevin wu: I'll hold off merging any more 4-bit fold changes until we confirm guard fixes and the regression harness passes.

priya rao: Assigning intl-annotators + legal-annotators for LB-4999. I'll post the updated guide link once done.

labeler-bot: LB-4999 progress: 500 queued -> 260 completed -> 17 HALLUCINATED/8 TRUNCATED/3 AMBIG.

olivia park: Summary for notes: "qz6b 4-bit fold shows hallucination/truncation on legal-long holdout; golden subset created and quarantined; curation to augment and dedupe; infra will add guards and CI regression check." :warning:
